hotel.hanoi@movenpick.com Near Hanoi city centre and Old Quarter Located in the heart of the city's business district, the Mövenpick Hotel Hanoi Centre is just 5 minutes walking to the centre or Old Quarter and 40 minutes' drive from Noi Bai International Airport. It takes only 2 minutes walking to the Friendship Palace Exhibition Centre and the hotel is about 8 km away from the National Convention Centre. Around the hotel Sights and attraction Hanoi's Old Quarter - 2 km Temple of Literature "Van Mieu" - 2 km Vietnam Fine Arts Museum - 1 km One Pillar Pagoda - 3 km Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum - 3 km How to get to the hotel From Noi Bai International Airport Airport pick up and transfer are available 24 hours. Our airport representative will personally welcome you upon arrival at the airport holding the Mövenpick Hotel Hanoi signage. Transfer will be charged at VND 1,260,000++ for 2 persons/way/Hotel normal car, or Mercedes at VND 1,500,000++ for 2 persons per way. Simply e-mail your flight details to hotel.hanoi.reservation@moevenpick.com and we will arrange this accordingly.
